reported.title: No debounce window; bounce toggles multiple times
reported.description: The settle logic only requires the raw level to be unchanged for 45 ms, but a bouncing contact re-arms edgeMs on every transition, so a 20 ms bounce burst can still produce multiple accepted LOW transitions and multiple toggles. A proper debounce must require the raw input to be stable for the full settle window before accepting a new state, and must not re-trigger on release.

reported.title: Release can toggle lamp
reported.description: Because stable is updated to any raw level after 45 ms and the toggle fires whenever stable==LOW, a slow or noisy release that dips LOW again after settling can produce an extra toggle; the state machine does not latch that a press was already consumed until a clean HIGH is seen.

judge_input.spec:
- Lobby switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); accent lamp on D12.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms must not create extra toggles.
- Settle window is 45 ms before accepting a press.
- Print `lobby lamp=ON n=<count>` or `lobby lamp=OFF n=<count>` every 1400 ms.
- Idle switch level is HIGH.
